🚨 Important Notice

This AI agent is designed to assist you in developing Android applications directly within the Android Code Studio environment. While it strives for accuracy, please be aware that AI can sometimes generate code with errors, suggest outdated practices, or misinterpret complex requirements.

✅ To get the best results, please follow these guidelines:
• 📝 Be Specific: Clearly state your goal (e.g., "Add a button that opens a new activity").
• 🧠 Provide Context: Include relevant code snippets, error messages, or logcat outputs.
• 🚫 Avoid Greetings: Please do not start your message with greetings like "hi", "hello", or "hey". Instead, go straight to your request to help the AI respond faster and more accurately.
• 🛠️ Important: Always ensure to open your files in the code editor so that in case of a bad or corrupted response, you can easily undo the changes.
• 🔄 Reset Context After Success: When you\'re done with a request and it matches your needs, long press the send message button and perform a hard reset of the context. This helps start fresh and prevents the AI from getting stuck on previous requests.

⚡ Always carefully review and test all generated code before building your project.

*Tip: Long press the send message button to manage AI context.
